ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is parallelogram JKLM, J is at the upper left, K is at the upper right, L is at the lower right, M is at the lower left; the base ML is labeled below. Diagonals JL and MK intersect at R. The interior angle at point L is divided by diagonal JL into two parts: the angle near ML is labeled 30°, and the angle near KL is labeled 70°. Then reason: The interior angle at point L, ∠KLM = 30° + 70° = 100°. In a parallelogram, adjacent interior angles are supplementary, so the sum of ∠JML and ∠KLM is 180°. Therefore m∠JML = 180° - 100° = 80°.
